item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q005_cupredoxin_function_transfer","answer":"In SCOPe 2.08 these are not three independent folds: representative azurins, ephrin ectodomains, and the PAD4 N-terminal domain all sit in class b, All beta proteins; fold b.6, Cupredoxin-like; superfamily b.6.1, Cupredoxins. They separate only at the family level: azurin/plastocyanin representatives such as d1a4aa_ and d3fs9a_ are b.6.1.1, Plastocyanin/azurin-like; human ephrin ectodomain representatives such as d2i85a_ and d2wo3b_ are b.6.1.5, Ephrin ectodomain; and human PAD4 N-terminal domain d4dkta1 is b.6.1.6, Peptidylarginine deiminase Pad4, N-terminal domain. Thus SCOPe supports a remote cupredoxin-superfamily relationship among these beta-sandwich domains, not membership in the same close family. Copper binding and electron-transfer chemistry are safe to transfer within well matched plastocyanin/azurin-like copper proteins only when the metal-binding context is conserved; they should not be inferred for ephrin ectodomains or PAD4 merely because those domains are in the Cupredoxins superfamily. The AlphaFold evidence for human Ephrin-B2 maps its ectodomain, roughly residues 25-166, to b.6.1.5 references, and evidence for human PAD4 maps its N-terminal region, roughly residues 2-112, to the PAD4 N-terminal b.6.1.6 reference d4dkta1; these are candidate structural/sequence matches and do not by themselves create official whole-model SCOPe classifications, exact boundaries, or function calls.","evidence_used":["get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/current","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a4aa_","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a4aa_/parents","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1a4aa_/annotations","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3fs9a_","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3fs9a_/parents","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d3fs9a_/annotations","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d2i85a_","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d2i85a_/parents","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d2wo3b_","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d2wo3b_/parents","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d4dkta1","get_scop_domains /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d4dkta1/parents","get_alphafold_hits /api/v1/releases/2.08/alphafolds/AF-P52799-F1/hits?limit=50","get_alphafold_hits /api/v1/releases/2.08/alphafolds/AF-Q9UM07-F1/hits?limit=50"]}]}
